question: In the context of microfinance in India, the concept of SHG-BLP is used. What does L stand for in SHG-BLP?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Linkage**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• SHG-BLP stands for **Self-Help Group - Bank Linkage Programme**.
 
• This programme was initiated by the **NABARD (National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development)** in 1992.
 
• The primary objective of the SHG-BLP is to **provide financial services to the rural poor** through the linkage of self-help groups with banks.
 
• It aims to **improve the socio-economic status** of the rural poor, particularly women, by providing access to formal banking services.
 
• The programme has been **instrumental in promoting financial inclusion** and empowering women across rural India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **NABARD**

 
 
• NABARD is the apex development bank in India with a mandate to facilitate credit flow for the promotion and development of agriculture, small-scale industries, cottage and village industries, handicrafts, and other rural crafts.
 
• It was established on **12 July 1982** by an act of the Parliament.
 
• NABARD's mission is to promote sustainable and equitable agriculture and rural development through participative financial and non-financial interventions, innovations, technology, and institutional development.
 
 
 
• **Self-Help Groups (SHGs)**
 
 
• SHGs are small voluntary associations of people, preferably from the same socio-economic background.
 
• The primary aim is to promote savings and thrift among members and provide loans to meet their credit needs.
 
• SHGs are usually formed around a common activity or purpose, such as farming, handicrafts, or small enterprises.
 
 
 
• **Financial Inclusion**
 
 
• Financial inclusion refers to the process of ensuring access to financial services and timely and adequate credit where needed by vulnerable groups such as weaker sections and low-income groups at an affordable cost.
 
• It aims to address and offer solutions to the constraints that exclude people from participating in the financial sector.
 
 
 
• **Women Empowerment**
 
 
• The SHG-BLP has been particularly successful in empowering women by providing them with financial independence.
 
• Women SHGs have contributed significantly to improving household incomes and community development.
